rounds.q: What % of a ripe red tomato is water?
rounds.why: USDA lists 94.52 grams of water in every 100 grams of tomato, and only 18 calories.
rounds.src: USDA FoodData Central, Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw (SR Legacy, 2019)
rounds.fun: A tomato is 95% water. Basically a juicy red water balloon!

rounds.q: How many seeds are on the outside of an average strawberry?
rounds.why: A strawberry takes about 30 days to grow from flower to fruit.
rounds.src: UMass Extension, Harvest of the Month: Strawberries (read 2026)
rounds.fun: 200 seeds on one berry, all grown in about 30 days. Busy little fruit!

rounds.q: How many feet tall was the tallest sunflower ever grown?
rounds.why: It hit 35 ft 9 in in 2025, beating a 30 ft 1 in record that had stood since 2014.
rounds.src: Guinness World Records, Tallest sunflower (2025 record)
rounds.fun: A sunflower almost 36 feet tall. Somebody get that flower a ladder!

rounds.q: How many inches can the fastest bamboo grow in a single day?
rounds.why: That's more than an inch an hour, and the tallest bamboo on record reached 130 feet.
rounds.src: Guinness World Records, Fastest growing plant (read 2026)
rounds.fun: 35 inches in a day is more than an inch an hour. You could watch it grow!

rounds.q: About how many rows of kernels run down a typical ear of corn?
rounds.why: Most ears have 14 to 18. The rows form in pairs, so the count is almost always even.
rounds.src: Purdue University Extension, Ear Size Determination in Corn (R.L. Nielsen)
rounds.fun: About 16 rows on an ear of corn, and almost always an even number. Go count!
